statusText: Tail risk low on an orderly overnight band; mapped policy state EA_ON with elevated Stress.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the watch threshold because the Globex evening band is narrow and Thursday's cash session closed 169 points above its low. Elevated Stress reflects the AI-led de-rating, yields near multi-decade highs and a crude supply premium. The narrow checkpoint is 13:30-15:00 UTC, covering the cash open and the Michigan preliminary release.
headline: Nasdaq-100 holds a narrow overnight band after a second AI-led decline
body: December NQ futures trade 30,976.50, up 0.02%, inside a 30,953.00-31,001.75 evening band, confirmed by a second delayed quote at 30,977.75. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed 30,725.81, down 1.39%, after a 30,556.40-31,125.13 range, so the session ended 169 points above its low rather than at the extreme. VIX settled 15.41, up 2.19%, which is a low absolute level for a 1.39% index decline, and the 10-year yield eased to 5.23% while the 30-year sat near 5.61% after an auction cleared 5.618% with 2.54 bid-to-cover. The driver was a Financial Times report that OpenAI's annualised revenue is about $20 billion below previously signalled figures, which cut US-listed chipmakers 3.4% on the day; Nvidia, Micron and Intel led the decline and the Philadelphia semiconductor index pared a drop of as much as 4%. A Nvidia-backed Australian data-centre operator also shelved a $5 billion listing on weak demand, and T-Mobile US fell about 5.4% after hours on a SpaceX spectrum acquisition. Crude settled higher, WTI at 91.18 and Brent at 104.11, on Hurricane Isaias approaching the US Gulf Coast, before easing after a statement that the United States would not strike Iran before the November 3 midterms; Iran is reviewing a US response on reopening the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. No persistent one-way NQ structure, failed-retracement sequence or session-extreme holding is observed at this assessment time, so Tail stays in the low band while the breadth of unresolved catalysts keeps Stress elevated. The shared Finviz context file was 9 days old and partial, so it was treated as stale and not used; the assessment rests on independently verified primary sources.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry published Claude assessments. Tail opened the day near 10-12 through the Asia hours with Stress in the high 40s, stepped into the watch band at the 07:00 UTC European handover and held 20-23 through the European and early US session as the AI-led decline developed. The 17:00 UTC hour was the single elevated reading at Tail 28 with Stress 72 while the semiconductor drop was steepest. Tail then decayed to 17-18 from 20:00 UTC onward as the cash session recovered off its low, volatility failed to expand and the evening Globex band narrowed, with Confidence steady at 85-89 throughout.
outlookSummary: The conditional path keeps Tail in the low band through the Asia and European hours, with a modest step up at the 07:00 UTC handover that reflects the prior session's analogue rather than observed structure. Tail crosses into the watch band from 12:00 UTC and peaks at 23 in the 14:00 UTC Michigan preliminary hour, with the narrow 13:30-15:00 UTC danger window covering the cash open and that release. Base case is decay back to the low band by 17:00 UTC on orderly two-way discovery, a brief watch-band return for the Friday final hour and 20:00 UTC cash close alongside a Fed Collins speech, then a low-band Friday evening. Confidence declines from 88 to 81 across the horizon. Weekend gap exposure from the Gulf Coast landfall and Iran's strait review is tracked as gap risk, not as intraday Tail.
